reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is well-grounded in established principles of magnetoelastic coupling, short-range ordering, and domain-pinning effects in high-entropy alloy thin films, making it scientifically coherent.
reasons.testability: It proposes clear, concrete experimental protocols and measurable outcomes (e.g., SQUID M(H) loops, ZFC/FC M(T), magnetocaloric isotherms), providing a direct path to falsification if results deviate from predictions.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis offers a comprehensive approach—combining specific processing, microstructural characterization, and magnetic measurements—that can guide researchers in systematically evaluating and optimizing the magnetocaloric performance of similar alloys.
